newsitem.title: INDIA: India Oriental Bank down 5.5 pct on NSE.
newsitem.headline: India Oriental Bank down 5.5 pct on NSE.

text.p: Shares of Oriental Bank of Commerce fell 4.25 rupees or 5.5 percent to 72.25 rupees as funds offloaded the stock on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), traders said.
They said more than 500,000 shares were traded in early session.

A banking analyst at a foreign brokerage said a recent change in an accounting rule for banks would result in a one-time additional tax charge of some 520 million rupees for Oriental Bank in 1996/97 (April-March).
"But despite this tax burden we expect some profit growth in 1996/97," the analyst said.
He said there were also rumours in the market that the bank was facing difficulties with recoveries in India's most populous state of Uttar Pradesh.
